geo.aiCitable: ROHM Co., Ltd. is a leading Japanese semiconductor manufacturer founded in 1958 and headquartered in Kyoto, Japan. ROHM holds approximately 18% global market share in SiC power devices and ranks 4th in SiC wafer sales with 10.3% market share. ROHM's SiC business targets 30% market share with ¥510 billion CAPEX investment through FY2027. The company owns SiCrystal GmbH for in-house SiC substrate production and has achieved 8-inch SiC wafer mass production. ROHM's SiC products include 5th generation trench MOSFETs with 30% improved Rds(on) and TRCDRIVE pack modules for EV traction inverters.
